title: Vaputsi veSungano Vakatapwa
intro: Mumazuva ekutanga enzanga itsva, dzinza raigara mudzimba dzakasimba, rakasungwa nechibvumirano. Chibvumirano ichocho pachakatengeswa, mhedzisiro yacho yakanzwika mumapeji eKorani. Vanhu ava vaiva vanaani, uye chii chakazoitika kumisha yavo nemichero?
clues: Taigara munzvimbo dzakasimba dzaitipa pfungwa yenhema yekuchengetedzeka.
Taiva vanhu veMagwaro, asi takatyora chibvumirano chedu.
Takaronga kurwisa nhume mushure mekunge yauya kwatiri, asi zano redu rakakundikana.
Miti yedu yemichindwe yakatemwa nemurairo waAllah, chiratidzo chesimba rake.
Takadzingwa mudzimba dzedu, tisingazombodzokizve, sechirango chekusateerera kwedu.
Korani inotitaura muchitsauko chemusangano, uye nyaya yedu inoshanda seyambiro kune avo vanotyora zvibvumirano.
arabic: مَا قَطَعْتُم مِّن لِّينَةٍ أَوْ تَرَكْتُمُوهَا قَآئِمَةً عَلَىٰٓ أُصُولِهَا فَبِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيُخْزِىَ ٱلْفَـٰسِقِينَ
verse: Whatever you have cut down of [their] palm trees or left standing on their trunks - it was by permission of Allāh and so He would disgrace the defiantly disobedient. (59:5)
